title: Analytical evaluation of an Ag-MOF photocatalyst for efficient malachite green degradation in wastewater: kinetics, mechanism, and stability
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46164-46177
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06391D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmed Hussain Jawhari, A. M. Ismael
A silver–niacin-based MOF was synthesized using a green solvothermal process and thoroughly characterized. The material demonstrated rapid and efficient photocatalytic degradation of malachite green dye with 97% removal in 90 minutes.
